name: BuchungsDesk Booking System
author: Mohanad Al-Karajeh

sections.description:
BuchungsDesk Booking System puts a booking form on your WordPress website. Customers book private lessons, lesson packs and group courses themselves and pay later, on site or by bank transfer. You see everything in one calendar and mark payments as paid; a numbered receipt is created automatically.

  • Private lessons and packs (for example 5 × 45 min) inside your opening hours
  • Group courses with places, dates, early-bird price and minimum participants
  • Waiting list for full courses: when someone cancels, the next person moves up automatically and gets an e-mail
  • Customer area: customers book and cancel their dates themselves (with your cancellation deadline) and can leave the waiting list
  • Admin calendar, customer list, payments and receipts, CSV export
  • Attendance list for group courses (tick who was there, per date)
  • Your own booking-form questions
  • Confirmation and reminder e-mails with calendar file (.ics)
  • Private calendar feed for your phone
  • No time limit, no licence key, no external services

Shortcodes: [buchungsdesk], [buchungsdesk_private], [buchungsdesk_groups], [buchungsdesk_account].

BuchungsDesk Online (hosted, paid) adds online payment, a team and more – see buchungsdesk.com. Plans: Solo for 1 trainer from 19 € per month, Pro for teams of up to 5 trainers from 39 € per month, Business on request. This plugin works fully on its own.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. BuchungsDesk → Settings: business details, opening hours, receipts.
  3. Create packages or group courses.
  4. Put [buchungsdesk] on a page and [buchungsdesk_account] on another page; choose that page under Settings → General.
sections.faq:
How do customers pay?

They book first and pay later, on site or by bank transfer. You mark the payment as paid and the receipt is created. You can add your bank details under Settings → General → Payment instructions.

How does the waiting list work?

Turn it on per course (it is on by default). When a course is full, new bookings go to the waiting list. When a place becomes free, the first person on the list gets the place and an e-mail. You can also move someone into the course by hand.

Does the plugin send data to other servers?

No. All bookings and customer data stay in your WordPress database. E-mails are sent with your site’s normal WordPress mail function.

Is there a paid version?

Yes. BuchungsDesk Online is a hosted booking system: online payment to your own Stripe or SumUp account, a team with several trainers, gift cards and discount codes, class cards and memberships, a phone app and a newsletter. It can be embedded in any website. Solo (1 trainer) costs 19 € per month or 190 € per year; a team of up to 5 trainers needs Pro, 39 € per month or 390 € per year; Business (unlimited trainers) is on request. See https://buchungsdesk.com/online/ – the free plugin stays free and works without it.

Is the plugin translated?

The plugin is written in English and ready for translation on translate.wordpress.org.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • The BuchungsDesk Online page and this description now show each plan with its number of trainers and price, so it is clear that teams start with Pro. Nothing else changes.

1.0.3

  • The “Pro version” page now shows BuchungsDesk Online, the hosted version. Nothing else changes.

1.0.2

  • New page “Pro version” in the menu and a link on the Plugins screen, so you can see what the Pro version adds.
  • Small hint on the Overview page, which you can hide.

1.0.1

  • Receipts show the date of service (course dates for courses).
  • Receipts stay as issued: business details are saved with each receipt when it is paid. Existing receipts are frozen with your current details on update.
  • Group course times now block private lessons at the same time.
  • Screenshots on the plugin page.

1.0.0

  • First release as BuchungsDesk Booking System.
